title: Cover health insurance and recurring healthcare
summary: Premiums, copays, prescriptions. The "I'll just be careful" plan is not insurance.
detailsHtml:
The math of going uninsured

A single emergency department visit averages $2,500–$5,000; a non-trivial inpatient stay can run $30,000–$100,000+. Going uninsured to save $400/month exposes you to a tail risk that single-handedly negates a decade of careful saving. This is not where the optimization happens.

HDHP consideration: If your employer offers a high-deductible health plan paired with an HSA, the math often favors choosing it — you get access to the most tax-advantaged account in the U.S. system. We'll address HSA prioritization in Phase 6.
